notes: No external sources read or used. Counts and coefficient numerators/denominators use exact integer arithmetic; g and V evaluated with 70 decimal digits and 85-digit 6/pi^2. V is inherently irrational; V_decimal retains its evaluated precision. Ratios label target grid: actual f(y)/x is recorded and used for normalisation and extrapolation. Cutoffs refer to the eight requested ratios; the extra .005 row checks lower-neighbor sensitivity. Formal regression standard errors measure residual scatter, not a proven asymptotic error. Persistent ratio dependence can bias the fixed-x exponent relative to a small-ratio limiting exponent; see ratio_dependence for its size and compare it to changes in x. Extrapolation model error need not be captured by the heuristic uncertainty envelope. No proofs are claimed.
